title: Common definitions
description: Definitions shared by every kind in opennfr.io/v1. One home per definition: a second copy is a second source, and two sources drift.

unit.description: Mandatory wherever a number needs one. Without it 0.1 is either a tenth of a percent or a tenth of a fraction and nobody can tell. The permitted set becomes a closed list once docs/units.md is ratified; until then any non-empty string parses.

aggregation.description: A closed enum plus a percentile pattern. The pattern is the one place this format admits a grammar rather than a list, and it is validated here rather than by a parser.

selector.description: Selects time series by attribute. {} means every series. A value of "*" means the attribute is present with any value. Attribute names are not enumerated — they are borrowed from OpenTelemetry.

annotations.description: The only extension point in the format. The opennfr.io/ prefix is reserved.
